what: White short-sleeve t-shirt, flat lay
notes: Straight from the front, whole shirt, centred. Even light grey background, soft light. Completely blank. Best t-shirt base.

what: Off-white / cream short-sleeve t-shirt, hanging on a white plastic hanger
notes: Front view, whole shirt, white wall, even light. Portrait format. WATCH OUT: small printed 'UNIQLO U' brand label inside the back neck is visible; retouch it out (small area, plain fabric around it). Chest and front are blank.

what: Dark navy short-sleeve t-shirt (curved hem), flat lay
notes: Front view, whole shirt, pure white background. Shirt fills only about 30% of the frame, so crop. WATCH OUT: white printed 'BROOTZ' neck label inside the collar and a tiny tag at the lower left hem; both need retouching. Curved scoop hem, not a classic straight hem.

what: Two black short-sleeve t-shirts on black wire hangers (navy substitute)
notes: Front view, both shirts whole, white wall, even light, no labels visible. Black, not navy: recolour to navy or crop to one shirt. Wide 2:1 format.

what: White long-sleeve crewneck, flat lay
notes: Front view, whole garment, blank. Light grey background, but with props around it (sneakers, plant, jeans under the right sleeve, basket, burlap); crop or clean these up. The garment is a heavier sweatshirt with ribbed cuffs and hem, not a thin long-sleeve tee.

what: Three black tops on wooden hangers: long-sleeve, short-sleeve, long-sleeve (navy substitute)
notes: White background, even light, no prints or labels visible. The right garment (washed black long-sleeve) is front-facing and whole; the left one looks like a back view. Black, not navy: crop the right garment and recolour to navy. The middle tee also works as an extra short-sleeve base.

what: White pullover hoodie on a white hanger, hanging from a rope
notes: Front view, whole hoodie, blank (white drawstrings with black tips, kangaroo pocket). Styled background: white and beige wall, dried palm leaves left, ripped jeans right, a frame with the word 'natur...' in the bottom right corner (background, not on the garment); crop it out. Can be recoloured light blue or grey.

what: Navy 5-panel baseball cap, three-quarter view
notes: Studio product shot cut out on pure white, sharp and even light. The front panel is completely blank. WATCH OUT: the brim has a removable OTTO sticker that is clearly visible; retouch it out (plain twill brim with stitching lines).

what: Washed cotton twill bucket hat, olive / grey-green
notes: Studio product shot cut out on pure white, slightly side-front view, completely blank (only eyelets and stitching). Olive, not cream: recolour to cream or beige (washed texture helps it look natural).

what: Natural cotton canvas tote bag, flat lay
notes: Front view, whole bag including handles, centred on an even mid-grey background, soft light. WATCH OUT: small navy circle-'b' logo in the bottom right corner of the bag; retouch it out (small, plain canvas around it). Otherwise blank.

what: Plain off-white soap bar on a ceramic dish, top-down (stand-in for surf wax)
notes: Top-down view, blank bar with no stamp, beige background with dappled leaf shadows on the right. The rounded square bar can pass for a wax bar; the top surface can take a print or label.

what: Stack of four plain white soap bars (stand-in for surf wax)
notes: Side or three-quarter view, blank bars, cream background with dappled light shadows. Portrait format. Better for a stack or lifestyle look than for showing a label.

what: Yellow beeswax blocks with two small bars
notes: Real wax texture, warm wood surface and log-cabin background (not plain). The large blocks are blank; the small bars on top have a faint embossed word. Use as wax texture or colour reference rather than as a clean base.

what: Silver D-shaped screw-gate carabiner (stand-in for brass and black)
notes: Lying diagonally on a plain white background, sharp, no markings. Silver, not brass or black: recolour (gold or brass tint, or dark anodised black). It is a screw-gate, not a wire-gate or keychain style.

what: Folded blue terry towel
notes: Three-quarter view on a white wooden surface against a white wall, even daylight, blank (only a woven dobby border band). Bath or hand towel, not a large beach towel; easy to recolour.

what: Pale aqua shortboard with dark navy rails and nose, standing upright in white sand (PARTIAL MATCH, fallback only)
notes: 2000x1496. Straight-on deck view, no stickers or logos, very plain pale background (white sand, hazy sea and sky). Real film photo (Mamiya 645 scan), so it has film grain and a few dust specks. Does NOT fully meet the brief: the tail is buried in sand (about 15% of the board not visible), the deck is pale aqua rather than cream (recolourable, but the dark rails and nose are part of the board), and there are faint scuff or drip marks on the lower deck. No clean, whole, cream or white, sticker-free board seen top-down on a plain background was found on free Unsplash.

what: Off-white / warm ecru heavyweight boxy tee (dropped shoulders, thick rib collar), front view, held up on a hanger by a hand, plain warm-grey wall, soft even daylight
notes: 1600x2400. Fabric colour about RGB(227,220,213), a warm off-white. Front chest and back are blank. Chest centre is about (790,1050); a chest print about 420px wide looks right (body runs about x 345-1245, collar bottom y 805). Neck label: a blue woven 'HOSEKI' label inside the back neck, partly visible through the neck opening, centre about (820,762), about 140x28px; there is also orange neck tape (x 625-1000, y 660-700). WATCH OUT: a blue woven 'HOSEKI' hem patch sits on the front lower right hem, centre about (888,2116), about 90x80px; retouch it out (plain fabric around it). The hanger hook and the hand are at the top right (hand about x 700-1600, y 330-560). The shirt hangs slightly tilted.

what: Beige / cream tee worn by a model, front torso crop (chin to waist, no face), light warm-grey studio wall
notes: 1600x976 (landscape). Fabric colour about RGB(225,216,199), a true cream/sand. Completely blank, no label visible. Chest centre is about (810,430); a chest print about 300px wide looks right (body x about 455-1045 at y 700, collar bottom y 255). The hem is cut off at the bottom edge. The fabric is midweight with a relaxed dolman-ish sleeve; it is clean and smooth with almost no folds, so a print will sit flat.

what: White heavyweight oversized/boxy tee, front view, whole shirt on a white wide-shoulder hanger on a steel rail, light grey wall, soft daylight
notes: 1600x2355 (portrait). Thick cotton with a wide rib collar and nice natural vertical drape folds: the best 'premium heavyweight' look. Chest is blank. Chest centre is about (765,1060); a chest print about 340px wide looks right (body x 420-1090, collar bottom y 835, hem about y 2200). Neck label: a printed white care/size label ('XL(180/96A) Made in China') inside the back neck, visible through the opening, centre about (788,753), about 55x70px; it is easy to retouch out or leave in. The hanger and rail are visible at the top.

what: White crew-neck tee, front view, whole shirt on a WOODEN hanger hanging from a wall hook, warm linen/plaster wall
notes: 1600x1067 (landscape). Very clean and centred. It looks like a studio render or AI-assisted mockup (very smooth). It is fine as a web mockup, but less 'real-fabric' than wit-voor-1. Completely blank, no label visible. Chest centre is about (800,470); a chest print about 250px wide looks right (body x 550-1048, collar bottom y 305, hem y 985). The wooden hanger is at the top centre (x 700-900, y 110-215).

what: White tee, BACK view, worn by a male model (head bowed, no face), warm off-white studio wall, soft light
notes: 1600x2400 (portrait). The back is completely blank, with no label visible. Back-print centre is about (670,1100); a back print about 400px wide looks right (the upper-back print top is about y 850). The back body runs about x 350-1010, the back collar is at about y 650-700 (centre x 650) and the hem is about y 2000. The torso is turned slightly, so the body centre is left of the image centre. The fabric is midweight, clean and smooth.

what: Navy / dark slate-blue tee worn by a male model, 3/4 front view, overcast daylight outdoors (blurred trees and sand-coloured ground)
notes: 1600x2397 (portrait). Fabric colour about RGB(31,34,39), a real dark navy. Completely blank, no label visible. The face is in the top half, so crop at y >= 1100 for a torso-only shot. Chest centre is about (640,1600); a chest print about 380px wide looks right, but it needs a slight perspective warp because the torso is turned to the right (visible front body x about 300-1000; collar bottom about y 1250-1290 at x 600-650). A diagonal crease runs from about (800,1250) to (900,1800). The hem is cut off.

what: BLACK crew-neck tee, front view, whole shirt on a white hanger against a white wall with soft window-light shadows
notes: 1600x1067 (landscape). NOTE: this is near-pure black (about RGB 11,10,10), not navy. It is used as the dark product shot because no good free blank navy hanger/flat-lay photo was found. Recolouring to navy works only as a tint and will look dark. Chest is blank. Chest centre is about (805,450); a chest print about 290px wide looks right (body x 525-1100, collar bottom y 270, hem about y 1015). Neck label: a BLANK white label inside the back neck, centre about (795,233), about 55x24px. The window-shadow diagonals cross the lower body. The fabric looks medium weight, not very boxy.

what: Black heavyweight boxy tee worn by a female model, front torso crop (lips to jeans/belt), editorial interior with a green tiled stove and dried grasses, soft daylight
notes: 1600x1069 (landscape). Very premium/editorial look; the thick fabric holds its shape. Black with a faint cool tint (about RGB 4,16,19). Completely blank, no label visible. Chest centre is about (870,380); a chest print about 260px wide looks right (body x 615-1130 at y 600, collar bottom y 185 at x 865, tucked hem about y 790). The left hand is on the hip; there are no props and no surfboard.

what: White oversized boxy tee (rolled sleeves) worn by a female model, BACK view, torso crop (no face), pure white studio background
notes: 1600x2229 (portrait). Thick, structured oversized fit with a clean large blank back, ideal for a big back print. Back-print centre is about (790,650); a back print about 480px wide looks right (back collar about y 150-200 centred x 770, shoulders x 250-1150, body x about 390-1230, hem about y 2030). There is no neck label, only a tiny loose thread at the collar at about (632,165), about 15px. The background is plain white, so it is less atmospheric; you could swap in a warm backdrop.

what: Stack of three soap bars, each with a plain paper wrapper band, on a pale wooden table against a white wall (stand-in for wrapped surf wax)
notes: 2400x3598 (portrait), stack small in the lower right. The bands are white linen-textured paper with a thin line of serif text (inpainted in echt_wax.py) and are almost frontal, so a print can be placed with a simple perspective quad. Band fronts: x about 1181 to 2073, y 2394 to 3292 (three bands). Bar ends are yellow, cream and speckled terracotta and are recoloured to the wax colour. Used for surfwax-*-1.

what: One white marbled soap bar standing upright on a wooden table with an old newspaper page and two dark leaves, warm beige wall, warm colour grade
notes: 3000x2000 (landscape, original size). The bar has embossed English text on the front (removed in echt_wax.py) and grey marble veins (removed with a greyscale closing and a smooth light fit). Bar silhouette about x 1312 to 2400, y 890 to 1731; a leaf overlaps the bottom edge around x 1650 to 2010. A 1600x2000 crop at x 1056 needs no scaling. Used for surfwax-*-2.

what: Fine light beige beach sand with gentle wind ripples, shot from straight above (3200x4262)
notes: Same photo as lifestyle/textuur-zand-1.jpg, at full resolution. Used by tools/tas/studio2.py for the close-up details (-3, -4) of the bags, so the sand grain keeps its real size when zoomed in. Soft overcast light, no objects.
